versions.changelog:
- Added a strict rule requiring a design to be presented and approved before any implementation, regardless of project simplicity.
- Introduced a HARD-GATE section explicitly forbidding code writing or implementation before design approval.
- Added an anti-pattern warning against skipping design for "simple" projects.
- Provided a checklist of required tasks to enforce sequence and completeness.
- Included a process flow diagram to clarify the brainstorming and approval steps.
- Changed implementation transition: after design approval, only the writing-plans skill may be invoked.
